effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
